meta.note: Curated seed snapshot. Records are confidence 'medium' until refreshed by the sync service from the device tree and layer index.

socs.name: i.MX 8M Mini
socs.dram: LPDDR4 training firmware (lpddr4_pmu_train_*.bin from firmware-imx, NXP EULA) loaded by U-Boot SPL

socs.name: i.MX 6ULL
socs.dram: DDR3L/LPDDR2 parameters live in the board-specific U-Boot DDR header (mx6ull ddr init); reuse the vendor board file

socs.name: AM335x
socs.dram: EMIF DDR3 timings in U-Boot board/ti/am335x (ddr_defs.h); reuse the TI board file

socs.name: STM32MP157
socs.boot: SD/eMMC via SDMMC, TF-A + U-Boot SPL
socs.dram: DDR timings are in the TF-A/U-Boot DDR device-tree (stm32mp15-ddr3-*.dtsi); reuse ST DDR settings and validate with the ST DDR tool

socs.name: RK3568
socs.boot: SD/eMMC, SPL with Rockchip DDR init blob (rkbin)
socs.dram: DDR init uses the Rockchip rkbin DDR blob (rk3568_ddr_*.bin); BSP reuses it from meta-rockchip

socs.name: BCM2711
socs.boot: SD via VideoCore firmware (start4.elf) then U-Boot or kernel
socs.dram: LPDDR4 is initialised by the VideoCore firmware; YBSG only writes the memory node

socs.name: AM625
socs.boot: SD/eMMC, TF-A + OP-TEE + U-Boot R5/A53 SPL
socs.dram: DDRSS configuration comes from the TI SysConfig-generated DDR dtsi; reuse the TI board DDR file and validate

socs.name: BCM2712
socs.boot: SD, USB or NVMe through the EEPROM bootloader, then the kernel directly (U-Boot only with RPI_USE_U_BOOT = "1")
socs.dram: LPDDR4X is initialised by the EEPROM bootloader; YBSG only writes the memory node
socs.label_source: https://github.com/raspberrypi/linux/tree/rpi-6.18.y/arch/arm64/boot/dts/broadcom (rp1.dtsi, bcm2712.dtsi, bcm2712-rpi-5-b.dts at 95b85beb) and meta-raspberrypi wrynose
